target.title: docs: restore source-backed contract details
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The published-doc rewrite in #100142 dropped or reworded several source-backed details. Current `main` consequently fails six documentation contract suites, including environment credential handling, cron fallback preflight, Talk defaults, MiniMax live guidance, release validation, and the canonical ClawHub package example.

## Why This Change Was Made

Restore the missing behavior descriptions from their owning source and repair the canonical plugin package snippet so its embedded copies remain complete and loadable. The patch changes documentation only; it does not weaken the contract tests.

## User Impact

Operators again see the exact current defaults and safety behavior. Plugin authors copying the minimal package example receive both the runtime `typebox` dependency and the OpenClaw host-SDK peer declaration.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/docs/environment-docs.test.ts src/docs/clawhub-plugin-docs.test.ts src/config/talk-defaults.test.ts src/cron/isolated-agent/run-fallback-policy.test.ts src/agents/minimax-docs.test.ts test/scripts/package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts` — 6 shards passed, 68 tests passed
- `pnpm docs:check-mdx` — 690 files passed
- `git diff --check` — passed
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` — clean after correcting the canonical package snippet

This repairs the baseline failures reproduced in [the post-merge `main` run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28729865562) and unblocks the focused pairing follow-up in #100179.
